problems: The third bullet says the map()/filter() family is affected but never says it is out of scope. The reviewers decided this patch does not fix the map()/filter() path, and the commit uses 'Task-number:' instead of closing the bug for that reason. An engineer following the card closely would likely try to fix map()/filter() too, which goes against that decision.

The third bullet also adds details the review never states: that ThreadEngine is non-auto-deleting, that it is 'started more than once', and that 'it also leaks'. These are unsupported and may be wrong.
The card leaves out the reviewer's request to extend the test to cover an attached .onCanceled() continuation running when the task is dropped.

The card leaves out the guard from the agreed fix: only cancel and finish the promise if it is not already finished (if (!promise.isFinished())). The card also does not say where the fix goes: report canceled and finished when the runnable is deleted without having run, in qtconcurrentrunbase.h, rather than changing the autoDelete check in QThreadPool.
